description: Fix all text overflow/clipping issues and standardize typography across the platform. Create a unified visual-final-polish.css file that consolidates all final corrections as the last-loaded CSS layer.
steps: Create a new CSS file frontend/src/styles/visual-final-polish.css that will be imported LAST in main.tsx (after owner.css). This file will contain all final polish corrections without modifying existing CSS files, preventing conflicts.
Add the import line to frontend/src/main.tsx: import './styles/visual-final-polish.css' as the very last style import.

In visual-final-polish.css, add comprehensive text overflow protection: (1) All headings (h1-h6, .page-title, .card-title, .landing-title, .landing-features-title, .dash-section-title, .welcome-card .page-title) must have overflow-wrap: anywhere and word-break: break-word. (2) All card body text (.card p, .card span, .metric-label, .alert-title, .alert-desc, .post-body, .notif-item-title, .notif-item-desc) must have overflow-wrap: anywhere. (3) All table cells (.tbl td, .tbl th) must have max-width: 280px, overflow: hidden, text-overflow: ellipsis, white-space: nowrap as defaults. (4) .topbar-scope must have max-width: 180px on mobile (<600px). (5) .landing-hero-float-card-value must have overflow-wrap: anywhere and word-break: break-word.

Add typography standardization rules: (1) Standardize body text to font-size: var(--fs-base), line-height: var(--lh-base), font-weight: 500. (2) Standardize all card titles to font-size: var(--fs-md), font-weight: 700, line-height: 1.3, letter-spacing: -0.01em. (3) Standardize all labels (.metric-label, .dash-eyebrow, .nav-section-label, .notif-panel-title, .filter-pill, label, .form-label) to font-size: var(--fs-xs), font-weight: 600, letter-spacing: 0.01em. (4) Standardize dashboard numbers (.metric-value, .kpi-value, .dash-gpa-value, .dash-term-pct, .dash-stat-value) to font-family: var(--font-sans), font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums, letter-spacing: -0.02em. (5) Standardize helper/subtle text (.card-subtitle, .text-muted, .text-subtle, .state-desc, .alert-desc) to font-size: var(--fs-xs), line-height: var(--lh-snug), color: var(--text-muted).

Add line-height consistency for Arabic text readability: (1) All paragraph text inside cards and pages must have line-height: var(--lh-base) (1.65). (2) All headings must have line-height: var(--lh-tight) (1.18). (3) All labels/badges must have line-height: 1.4. (4) All button text must have line-height: 1.

Ensure long Arabic text in .landing-subtitle, .landing-final-cta-lede, .page-subtitle, .landing-bento-desc has text-wrap: pretty and max-width constraints (max-width: 64ch for subtitles, 72ch for body paragraphs).
Fix the .topbar-title overflow issue: ensure the title container clips properly with min-width: 0, overflow: hidden on the flex parent and text-overflow: ellipsis on the text content.
Fix .sidebar-brand-name .ai-tag potentially overflowing: add flex-shrink: 0 and ensure it stays on one line.
acceptance_criteria: No text overflows its container anywhere in the platform
Typography uses consistent sizing/weight from the token system throughout
All headings, body text, labels, and numbers follow the defined hierarchy
Arabic text has adequate line-height for readability (min 1.4 for body, 1.18 for headings)
The new CSS file loads last and does not conflict with existing styles
Long text in cards, tables, and navigation gracefully truncates or wraps
verification: Read visual-final-polish.css and verify all selectors reference valid class names from the existing CSS
Read main.tsx and confirm the import is the last style import
Grep for any syntax errors (unclosed braces, missing semicolons) in the new file
findings: Created visual-final-polish.css (188 lines) as the last-loaded CSS layer. All 7 var() references validated against tokens.css. Braces balanced (21/21). Import placed after owner.css in main.tsx. No existing CSS files were modified. The task spec table max-width value (300px) and topbar-scope max-width (140px) follow the delegating prompt rather than the feature steps (280px/180px) since the prompt provides the authoritative CSS content.
